title: 第六章 无害微笑使用
slug: 看见罪犯词条我成了警局团宠
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“我……”黎雾咽了咽口水，佯装无事发生道：

“我昨晚回来就睡了，没听见什么声音。”

“警察叔叔，你们这边有什么线索，一定要快点把这个杀人犯给抓住。”

黎雾一边说，一边强行控制脸上不要出现惊恐感，更不要朝这个男人头顶上看。

此时她不由得庆幸，幸好自己能够看到所有人头上的词条。

杀人犯伪装警察上门例行询问，即使自己是社恐，遇到这样的事，也会把昨天遇到黑衣男人的事说出来。

而一旦说出来，等待她的可能就是死亡。

黎雾目光下垂，落在了黑衣男人从始至终都放在身后的右手上。

心脏快跳出嗓子眼，放在门框上的手心中全是汗水。

这人的手上，该不会拿的是刀吧！

念头在脑海中一闪而过，就听到男人沙哑的质疑声响起，阴恻恻的：

“是吗？”

“是啊是啊。”黎雾连连点头，脸上下意识的扬起了几分笑。

“我昨晚回来就睡了，什么声音都没听到。”

“楼上的人现在情况怎么样。”

随着黎雾话落，一道冰冷无机质的声音在脑海里响起。

【滴！——无害微笑正在使用。】

站在黎雾对面的男人，本来是打算黎雾无论说什么，都要把她给解决掉的。

谁让她运气不好，早不回家，晚不回家。

偏偏昨晚回家的时候和他给撞上了。

他绝不允许有任何关于他的线索被人发现。

要怪就怪这人运气不好。

正要动手，抬眼看到的就是黎雾脸上的微笑。

【无害微笑（你拥有善良天使般无害的微笑，哪怕穷凶极恶之人，看到你的微笑也会忍不住心软）】

何明心神一阵恍惚。

眼中的杀意开始逐渐褪去，黑沉沉的眸子在黎雾脸上一扫而过。

要是再杀一个，事情闹得太大不划算。

既然没看到，那就放她一马。

冰冷阴恻恻的声音响起：

“我们现在正在全力排查凶手，你有什么线索，一定要第一时间跟我说。”

“这段时间没事少出门知道吗？”

黎雾闻言连连点头，忙不迭道：

"I..." Li Wu swallowed and pretended that nothing happened:

"I fell asleep when I came back last night and didn't hear anything."

"Police uncle, if you have any clues here, we must catch this murderer as soon as possible."

As Li Wu spoke, he forcibly controlled not to show panic on his face, let alone look at the man's head.

At this moment, she couldn't help but feel lucky that she could see the entries above everyone's heads.

The murderer pretends to be a policeman and comes to the house for routine questioning. Even if he is a terrorist, if he encounters such a thing, he will tell the story about the man in black yesterday.

And once she says it, death may be waiting for her.

Li Wu lowered his gaze and landed on the right hand of the man in black that had been placed behind him from beginning to end.

My heart was beating out of my throat, and my palms on the door frame were covered in sweat.

Could this man be holding a knife in his hand?

The thought flashed through my mind, and I heard the man's hoarse voice of questioning, pitiful:

"Really?"

"Yes, yes." Li Wu nodded repeatedly, a smile subconsciously appearing on his face.

"I fell asleep when I came back last night and didn't hear anything."

"How are the people upstairs doing now?"

As Li Wu finished speaking, a cold, inorganic voice sounded in his mind.

【drop!——Harmless Smile is in use.】

The man standing opposite Li Wu originally planned to get rid of Li Wu no matter what she said.

Who makes her unlucky? She doesn't come home early or late.

It happened that I bumped into him when I was going home last night.

He would never allow any clues about him to be discovered.

The blame is on this guy's bad luck.

Just as he was about to take action, what he saw when he looked up was the smile on Li Wu's face.

[Harmless smile (you have a harmless smile like a good angel, even the most vicious people will feel soft when they see your smile)]

He Ming was in a daze.

The murderous intent in his eyes began to gradually fade away, and his dark eyes swept over Li Wu's face.

If he kills another one, things will get too big and it won't be worth it.

Since you didn't see it, let her go.

A cold and pitiful voice sounded:

"We are now doing our best to investigate the murderer. If you have any clues, you must tell me as soon as possible."

"Don't go out during this period if you have nothing to do, you know?"

Li Wu nodded repeatedly when he heard this and said hurriedly:
